notes.title: Grrrr......
notes.content:
Collectors, hear me! A massive monster has been detected in motion. 
Prepare for immediate combat readiness!
It seems that the prosperity of the settlement has awakened a massive monster.
We must survive no matter what.

[Pollution]
Now, true survival skills are necessary to survive on Earth. 
The Earth is becoming more and more polluted, and pollution from Larva is becoming 
increasingly serious. Pollution levels have reached levels 4 and 5.

[Monster]
monster large enough to shake the settlement has joined the battle.
It is massive, sinister, and capable of destroying the settlement in an instant. 
This giant monster appears starting from pollution level 4


And I have a message for our supporters.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2296870/discussions/0/3819656548998957316/

notes.title: Hot fix
notes.content:
hello Supporters I'm sorry that we have to meet through a hotfix notice.
We have conducted a hotfix update for the freezing issue with heroes during gameplay
We appreciate the user who provided assistance

Also, small bugs have been fixed and some balancing adjustments have been made.

[Tower pack]
The attack power, range of the 'Tesla Core' have been increased.

[Monster]
The unit summoning speed of 'Rockmeira' will be faster.

[Tutorial]
The tutorial guide is displayed properly when the P key is pressed

We are providing guidance through a link regarding the black screen issue
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2296870/discussions/0/5940851794734420781/

Thank you very much

notes.title: The early access version has been released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43605215/76793a0df2253c3ade2260c6acf7a3acc65b58ad.png[/img]
Hello, early access users. Thank you for loving Crimson Connect Origin.
First of all, we would like to inform you about the update schedule briefly.

We hope to have more updates based on your opinions during the development process. We plan to listen to the opinions of our users and adjust our development accordingly through the forum. We appreciate your active participation.
